as_told.title: Jack Parsons' past life as Simon the Sorcerer

plain: The American rocket engineer Jack Parsons is said to have gone through a past-life regression, a practice of recalling supposed earlier lives, and found that he had been Simon the Sorcerer, an ancient magician figure. Michels tells this himself, and in another episode places it in the OTO, an occult society linked to the English occultist Aleister Crowley, where he says such regressions were done. It is told as part of the strange link between early rocketry and the occult.
